events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast 2026
events.datetime: Mon 20 Jul - Sun 26 Jul, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM daily
events.location: Various artist studios across the Sunshine Coast
events.description: Explore diverse local artist studios across the Sunshine Coast, featuring mediums like ceramics, painting, photography, and woodworking. Connect directly with makers, witness their craft, and discover unique artworks, with optional hands-on workshops available.

events.title: Noosa Alive! Festival 2026
events.datetime: Mon 20 Jul - Sun 26 Jul, throughout the day and evening
events.description: Experience Noosa's premier arts and culture festival featuring ten days of music, theatre, literature, comedy, and film. This festival gathers local and international artists in beautiful settings for a relaxed, world-class program.

events.title: COPING with WINTER by DAVID WILLIAMSON (Preview)
events.description: A preview performance of David Williamson's new play, "COPING with WINTER," presented as part of the Noosa Alive! Festival at The J Theatre.
